name: moe-mixtral-8x7b
note: Sparse MoE FFN block (Mixtral 8x7B): hidden 4096, 8 experts, top_k 2, per-expert SwiGLU intermediate 14336. norm -> router (4096->8 expert logits) -> the two activated experts' SwiGLU FFNs (each up 4096->14336, SiLU, down 14336->4096). top_k=2 is modeled as two sequential expert FFN passes (the per-token matmul volume); real routing/gather/scatter and gate*up are not expressible in the linear-chain format.
